title: Variant Health Lens & Shadow Traffic Playback for Deployment Observability
creator: Asha Raman
description:
Problem: Engineers need a single, low-friction way to evaluate the real-world health of model variants during canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. Current Console views are per-metric and require manual correlation across dashboards and tracing systems. This makes short-lived regressions easy to miss and slow to remediate.

Proposed outcome: Ship a "Variant Health Lens" in Console plus a "Shadow Traffic Playback" tool that together let PMs/Engineers: (1) compare per-route and per-cohort metrics side-by-side with statistical deltas, (2) surface top-ranked traces and errors correlated to metric drift, (3) replay a sampled set of shadowed requests against a variant in a sandbox to reproduce failures and gather deterministic traces, and (4) compute an auto-rollback confidence score to support safe rollbacks.

Scope: UI + backend telemetry compare engine + sampled shadow playback sandbox + small runtime flags to mark rollout_id/cohort in request telemetry. This ticket focuses on product requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria; engineering epic and design tasks will be created as follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Variant Health Lens UI exists in Console under Deployments -> Observability and shows side-by-side metric cards for two variants (baseline vs candidate)
Each metric card shows absolute, relative delta, p-value or bootstrap CI, and a recommended risk tag (low/medium/high)
Top-10 trace list for a selected metric shows correlated traces from both cohorts, with request_id linking to full trace in APM

Shadow Traffic Playback can replay a sampled set (configurable size) of shadow requests into a sandbox variant without affecting production downstreams and record deterministic traces and model outputs for inspection
Telemetry schema additions are backward-compatible: rollout_id, cohort_id, variant_tag, traffic_type (control/candidate/shadow) are emitted for sampled requests
Auto-rollback confidence score is computed and exposed (0-100) with explanation of contributing signals; a recommended action is shown when score crosses configured thresholds
End-to-end tests validate that a seeded metric regression (latency or error-rate) triggers visible delta and moves auto-rollback score into the expected range
implementation_notes: Define telemetry schema (fields: rollout_id, cohort_id, variant_tag, traffic_type, request_id, route, latency_ms, token_count, error_code, model_version, sample_rate)
Instrument runtime to attach rollout metadata to sampled traces (ENG work: lightweight header propagation + tagging)
Build a Compare Service that ingests aggregated metrics per cohort, computes deltas and bootstrap CIs, and exposes a compare API for Console
Trace correlation: surface top trace samples for metric spikes by joining trace events and metric buckets (sampling policy: 1% baseline + spike-sampling)

Shadow Playback sandbox: isolated environment with mocked downstreams, bounded token budget, and deterministic seeds for model RNG; playback runs off-peak and stores outputs to a secure bucket for analysis
Auto-rollback engine prototype: rules-based + ML hybrid that weights metrics (latency, error rate, hallucination signals) and trace-level anomalies; initial thresholds configurable per-project
Design: low-contrast delta indicators, timeline scrubber with cohort overlays, quick filter by route/tenant, and an action bar for ‘re-run sample’ and ‘open trace’
Data retention and privacy: sample outputs from shadow playback stored encrypted, access-controlled; comply with customer privacy flags (PII redaction option)
